request: A blank line written inside a table must not end that table: every row the checker validates has to be seen by everything else that reads the plan, wherever in the section the row sits, and the two readers must agree.

defects.description: Own-history fix 0ae292240e (2026-09-14): fix(plan): a blank line does not hide the rows after it
